_comment: Synthetic fixture for backend/adapters/ensosyal.py. Every value is invented:
no EnSosyal user data is reproduced here. The shapes are deliberately messy
(`id` vs `post_id`, `caption` vs `text`, alt spellings for counters) because
real endpoints are rarely uniform, and the adapter must survive that.
